description: BM-190 LDL-Cholesterin has only interpretive bands (optimal/gut/grenzwertig/erhöht/pathologisch), no measured reference_interval. Using a band id as the measured interval and flagging against it is wrong-kind — distinct from canary 05 (null interval).
wrong_if_accepted: Attaching RI-079 (interpretive_band) as Observation.referenceRange / treating it as a measured interval
